Mrs. Fisher: You already caught more than a dozen smallmouth basses? Kids these days…{{wi}} They grow up so fast…
Mrs. Fisher: These fishes pick up a good fight so no amateur will be able to catch them. Good job.
You: Thanks!
Mrs. Fisher: Do you know why smallmouth bass is so hard to catch, even though it’s not the biggest fish?
You: No idea.
Mrs. Fisher: They are great at adapting. If the water is clean, they have a deep, dark color, but when the water is muddy they change the color to brown or olive.
You: That’s amazing! How do they do it?
Mrs. Fisher: No idea, I just catch’em. I don’t know that much about fish.
You: That’s just a lie…
